body.value: The three products of which Contoso shifted the most individual items, best first, with how many items: Adventure Works Desktop PC1.80 ED180 Brown 1,542 units, Adventure Works Desktop PC2.30 MD230 Black 1,482 units, Adventure Works Desktop PC1.80 ED182 Black 1,474 units. The figure counts PIECES — the quantity on every sale line that named the product, added up — so one order taking three of something contributes three; it is not a count of orders, lines or customers. It covers every order on record, 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31, and both channels, the web shop and the walk-in shops together. WHAT IS NOT IN IT: nothing is netted off for returns, refunds or cancellations, because this bundle records none — no such column exists and no line carries a negative quantity, so gross and net are the same number here. No category, brand, country, store or trading-state restriction was applied. And these are SKUs: ED180 Brown and ED180 Black count as two different products, which is the level this warehouse calls a product. The third place is not close-run — fourth has 1,462 units, so no tie-break was needed.

turns.why: Price the declared fork in "quantity sold" in one shot — units summed versus orders the product appeared in — by computing both per product and returning everything ranked top-5 on either reading, so I can see whether the two readings pick the same three products and whether anything is tied at the cut.
turns.did:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_key,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(s.quantity) AS units_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_key) AS orders_with_product,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_lines
  FROM contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  JOIN contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
    ON s.product_key = p.product_key
  GROUP BY
    p.product_key,
    p.product_name
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    agg.*,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS rank_by_units,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY orders_with_product DESC) AS rank_by_orders
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  product_key,
  product_name,
  units_sold,
  orders_with_product,
  sales_lines,
  rank_by_units,
  rank_by_orders,
  (
    SELECT
      MIN(quantity)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS min_line_quantity,
  (
    SELECT
      MAX(quantity)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS max_line_quantity
FROM ranked
WHERE
  rank_by_units <= 5 OR rank_by_orders <= 5
ORDER BY
  rank_by_units

SELECT
  p.product_name,
  SUM(s.quantity) AS units_sold,
  (
    SELECT
      MIN(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS first_order_date,
  (
    SELECT
      MAX(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  ) AS last_order_date
FROM contoso_served.dim_product AS p
JOIN contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
GROUP BY
  p.product_key,
  p.product_name
ORDER BY
  units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
